"errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000" exceeds the USD 1M floor

reasons: All six atomic preferred elements (CGL per-occurrence and aggregate limits, E&O 2M, conditional cyber 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request) appear in operative language of new paragraph (j).

The insertion is a concise new covenant for an entirely absent clause; no existing sentence was rewritten and no extraneous boilerplate (e.g., additional insured, waiver of subrogation, post-term tail) was added.
No undefined term, contradiction, or dangling mechanic is introduced; 'Sparkling's data' is used descriptively and the cyber limit is properly conditioned on Vendor processing/access.
Fallback floors are exceeded by the preferred limits, so the fallback bargain would also be satisfied on its material terms.
